<function name="SetFlexScale" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the scale of all the flexes of this entity. See <page>Entity:SetFlexWeight</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="scale" type="number">The new flex scale to set to</arg>
	</args>
</function>
